svg.text: Flight dynamics, control-law design and simulation
Trim a nonlinear aircraft, linearise about the trim, and read off a modal table whose labels come from eigenvector participation.
For a real root ω is 1/T, and it has no ζ.
s-plane, units of 1/s · NT-33A at sea level, M = 0.204, trimmed to 2.15° alpha · poles as computed by galata 0.2.0
